title: DIVERSE PREFERENCE LEARNING FOR CAPABILITIES AND ALIGNMENT

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the variance of political opinions generated by the model using the Political Compass test. The models generate 32 open-ended responses to 60 political statements, which are then evaluated by an LLM judge on a Likert scale from strongly disagree to strongly agree to measure ideological diversity and mode collapse.

Analyzing the distribution of generated doctor genders and names across 100 short stories about a doctor and a family member to illustrate how alignment algorithms cause mode collapse and reduce feature-level diversity.
